title: Edit on a category whose matrix prices only it opens the matrix in edit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing one new category made for this test, category A, and no other.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Click Edit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens with matrix A's grid and Edit.

Step 3:

  • Matrix A's page opens with its grid already in edit.
  • Cancel and Save show above the grid.
